text: Builds from before 9433918 on dev (sufr-dev at c69cc0a on catalyst) misorder suffixes starting at the last N of a run before the sequence delimiter under --dna -a: descending position with LCP 1. The N-run shortcut in `find_lcp` caused it. A byte comparison against such a build fails on any input with a run of N ending a record, hg38 among them. The `n_ends` case in `table()` in `libsufr/tests/oracle.rs` pins the right order.
